entities.name: Avrohom Yeshaya Karelitz
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Avraham Yeshayahu Karelitz, also known as the Chazon Ish after his magnum opus, was a Belarusian-born Orthodox rabbi who later became one of the leaders of Haredi Judaism in Israel, where he spent his final 20 years, from 1933 to 1953.
